PRIVACY & ENQUIRIES

A little clarity.
Before you say hello.

What you share

Our enquiry forms ask for your name, business, contact details, location and coffee requirements. Please share only what is relevant to your enquiry.

How enquiries are sent

The form prepares a message for WhatsApp or your email app. You review and send it there. Form entries are not submitted to a website database or stored in your browser by this website.

Who receives your message

Enquiries go to Bermito Coffee Labs LLP, the business behind Ploomi. We use the information you send to respond and discuss coffee, sampling, quotations and related services.

External services

WhatsApp, your email provider and the site hosting provider process information under their own policies. External links open those services. We have not added advertising trackers or newsletter subscriptions to this website.

Questions or changes

To ask about your enquiry information, request a correction or ask us to delete correspondence, email hello@bermito.com.

Commercial details

Wholesale coffee has no minimum order quantity. Wholesale delivery across Kerala is free. Samples are paid and carry delivery charges. Availability, quotations, sample fees, schedules and payment terms are confirmed directly before an order is agreed. The three blend illustrations are concepts, not confirmed product specifications.
